turns.speaker: assistant

turns.text: Not too many. After we ate, I decided to get some movement in, so I did a long session of mindful flow and deep stretching on my mat in the living room.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Yeah, I wrapped up everything on my list. Now I'm back home, just taking it easy while Leah is out at her pottery class. I might jump online for a quick game of chess in a bit.

turns.speaker: assistant
